architecture:
  services:
  - name: greeter
    path: services/greeter
    language: go
    public_interface:
      kind: cli
      document: docs/greeter-cli.yaml
  concepts:
  - concept: greeting
    block: given
    service: greeter
    references:
    - file: greeting-config
    does: Write the expected greeting to the configuration file before running greet.
  - concept: request greeting
    block: when
    service: greeter
    references:
    - command: greet
    does: Run greet once with the person argument set to the named person and the
      loud flag omitted, so the configured greeting is printed verbatim and one greeted
      log record is emitted.
  - concept: greeting
    block: then
    service: greeter
    references:
    - log_record: greeted
    does: Observe the greeted log record and compare its greeting to the expected text.
  terms:
  - term: greeting
    technical: Text supplied to greet and recorded in the greeted log record.
    observed_by: Set the greeting configuration and compare the greeted text.
